artboards.title: 1 · The condensed spine names the place
4 · The theme row says what it does

annotations.text:
SIX REFINEMENTS, each independent, each reversible — found by driving the shipped frame, not by imagining a new one.

Every proposal names its cost or tradeoff. Nothing here touches the phone: the one phone-shaped idea (a bottom dock) was considered and dropped — it reverses a deliberate, gated decision (one nav, in the header) for no gain the canvas itself could defend.

Say which numbers to build — 1, 2 and 4 are an afternoon; 3 re-aims existing checks and is the only one with real gate surgery.
1 is the lead: it fixes the one genuine REGRESSION the redesign introduced — the condensed header used to name the record you were in, and the spine currently doesn't.
